title: Niffty Laugh
blurb: Niffty is roughly a foot tall, obsessed with cleaning, and by a considerable margin the most unhinged resident of the Hazbin Hotel. Her laugh is a high, fast, delighted giggle that arrives at moments no reasonable person would find funny, and the fandom adores it for exactly that. Two seconds is plenty. It slots neatly into any edit where something has gone badly wrong and one character is having a wonderful time about it, and works equally well as a Discord reaction to a friend's terrible idea.
